package.name: niryo_world_model
package.description: Symbolic world model for the Niryo Ned2 planning stack. Holds the static map of stations, generates the transit waypoints and the graph topology, and fuses the perceived scene with arm and gripper state into symbolic facts. Serves both a one-shot scene snapshot for building the PDDL problem and the continuous human occupancy and path clearance queries the safety monitor polls at runtime
